name: Neon

identity.oneLiner: Synthwave nights: magenta–cyan chrome on deep violet, grid horizon optional.
identity.summary: Neon/Synthwave is high-contrast dark-first romance: chrome bezels, scanline/grid backdrops at high fidelity, and magenta/cyan accents. Glow is decoration only — contrast must pass without it. Light mode is a washed Miami daytime dialect of the same geometry.
identity.authenticityNotes: Chrome + grid + dual accent beats rainbow. Prefer one horizon/grid plane, not every panel glowing.

axes.shape: Slightly squared with chrome bevel; perspective grid only in backdrop slots
axes.surface: Deep violet/navy lacquer; subtle scanline noise
axes.elevation: Hard neon rim + dark drop; bloom is cosmetic
axes.ornament: Grid horizon, sun disc, scanlines via backdrop/ornament
axes.typeVoice: Tech display for titles; readable sans for UI; mono accents
axes.motion: Pulse/glow optional; must respect reduced motion (static rim remains)
axes.density: Showy marketing density; tighten for app chrome

bands.description: Structure hints only: radius, type voice, subtle edge. No ornaments.
Clear era geometry and materials; sparse ornaments on surfaces.
Full decorative program. Demo/showcase territory; neverDo still binds.

dialects.label: Synthwave
dialects.description: Dark violet nights, magenta/cyan, grid sun.

dialects.label: Miami
dialects.description: Daytime pastel aqua/pink, palm-adjacent, softer bloom.

neverDo: Glow never counts toward WCAG contrast — text/icons must pass on flat fills.
Never put Orbitron on Button/TextField/Switch labels.
Never stack multiple full-bleed grids; one backdrop plane per view.
Never use pure #ff00ff on pure #00ffff for small text.

button.shadow: 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ew-color-border-subtle) 80%, transparent), 0 0 12px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ew-color-action-bg) 35%, transparent)
button.bevel: inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in oklch, white 35%, transparent), inset 0 -1px 0 color-mix(in oklch, black 35%, transparent)

card.raisedShadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--ew-color-border-strong), 0 0 28px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ew-color-action-bg) 40%, transparent), 0 16px 40px color-mix(in oklch, black 55%, transparent)
